findings.cause: Timer selection used current wall time while proof acceptance used the last state clock tick; an early callback followed by an effect after expiry could remove the only expiry wakeup. A delayed browser timer also left submission-time proof checks stale.
findings.fix: Select pending deadlines relative to the rendered clock state; rearm timer callbacks directly until the actual clock reaches expiry, including repeated identical clock observations; check current time separately in submission event handlers. Keep rendering pure, clean up the latest timer, preserve exact expiry duration and backend proof enforcement.
boundaries: Valid immediately before exact expiry, invalid at expiry

Proof state update rendered after expiry returns to verification
Repeated early callbacks at the same observed millisecond rearm directly without relying on React state changes
